name: PeopleOS People Intelligence System
purpose: Investigate workforce questions using governed deterministic analytics, traceable evidence, explicit data/model lifecycle, and bounded AI synthesis without automating consequential employment decisions.

controls.mechanism: Validated loopback Host/Origin plus server-token identity for remote requests; centralized mutation permissions; legacy file sessions retired
candidate-only model activation after deterministic evaluation
L2 recovery envelope excludes HR data/actions and model activation
Shared runtime lock; prepare-before-commit activation; dataset fingerprints and artifact checksums; incompatible requests rejected
Declared numeric measurement contract; exact categorical/ID lexemes; sparse status preservation; oversized imports rejected
Shared probability and population validation for API/agent; missing/zero distinction and dataset-switch cache reset in UI
Component-specific source score sample thresholds, common weights, survey population reconciliation and coverage metadata
LLM selects verified evidence IDs; server renders factual claims; required metrics and unsupported scopes checked
Invalid registry fails closed at startup; explicit runtime recovery verifies an exclusive quarantine before shell replacement and remains degraded pending dataset reconciliation

risks.description: Only the local data runtime is supported; all evidence is bound to a dataset generation and shared mutation boundary
Upload initializes read-only analytics; explicit model activation validates snapshot and score population before committing
frontend migration must pass Next.js 16 build

signals: runtime dataset fingerprint matches loaded frame
registry dataset and runtime identity agree
model output covers exactly the current active IDs
desktop and mobile browser journeys green for candidate commit
health.loop: Desired state -> Sense -> Detect -> Diagnose -> Authorize -> Respond -> Recover -> Verify -> Learn

build_steps.name: Resolve immutable desktop configuration
build_steps.trigger: desktop workspace initialization and API health check
build_steps.action: Normalize the module-relative config path before opening it; preserve the PEOPLEOS_HOME database override.
build_steps.state_transition: bundled config unread -> configuration loaded -> workspace can initialize
build_steps.control: Read immutable config from the bundle, independent of cwd; never create missing package directories or rewrite bundled config.
build_steps.exceptions: A genuinely missing config must still raise FileNotFoundError and fail the packaged smoke gate.
build_steps.recovery: Correct the PR candidate and rebuild; do not bypass health checks or change user data.
build_steps.verification: tests/test_local_distribution.py covers absent/present src directories, spaces, unrelated cwd and PEOPLEOS_HOME.
build_steps.completion_evidence: Local Desktop Build passes API/UI smoke checks on Windows x64, macOS ARM64 and Linux x64 for the same candidate.
build_steps.validation: A packaged app can initialize its local workspace and serve its UI without an installed source tree.

baseline_evidence.observed: Windows passes; macOS and Linux fail opening _MEI.../src/../config.yaml and return HTTP 500 during smoke.

build_steps.target: All three packaged smoke jobs pass with existing launcher, packager and Windows settings preserved.
build_steps.rollback: Revert this config-path change if the candidate regresses Windows; retain the previous diagnostics and packaging settings.

build_steps.name: Preserve input identity and measurement populations
build_steps.action: Read exact lexemes; map declared fields; retain sparse outcomes; reject missing IDs and oversized inputs
build_steps.control: No implicit truncation or cross-dataset SQLite merge
build_steps.recovery: Reject with actionable validation error; previous snapshot stays active
build_steps.completion_evidence: Known-answer and fault-injection regression contracts pass
build_steps.validation: Result fidelity and real-world measurement validity remain separate; prospective organizational validation required for stronger predictive claims

build_steps.name: Commit a verified dataset snapshot
build_steps.action: Prepare engines and preprocessing in isolation, verify artifact bytes, commit metadata/runtime under the shared local mutation lock, clear auxiliary caches
build_steps.control: Registry, runtime and auxiliary result scope stay aligned
build_steps.recovery: Retain previous snapshot on preparation/storage failure; reject conflicting requests
build_steps.completion_evidence: Known-answer and fault-injection regression contracts pass
build_steps.validation: Result fidelity and real-world measurement validity remain separate; prospective organizational validation required for stronger predictive claims

build_steps.name: Validate and commit a model
inputs: Active dataset identity, evaluated artifact, current active rows
build_steps.action: Fit only bound data; validate transformed scores before activation; recover missing artifacts through a real retraining attempt
build_steps.control: No metadata activation before successful scoring; no retired/missing artifact reuse
build_steps.recovery: Keep previous active model/runtime on failure
build_steps.completion_evidence: Known-answer and fault-injection regression contracts pass
build_steps.validation: Result fidelity and real-world measurement validity remain separate; prospective organizational validation required for stronger predictive claims

build_steps.name: Reconcile measured cohorts
inputs: Matched survey rows and current employee population
build_steps.action: Choose latest eligible survey responses, compute totals before truncation, compare source scores on common supported components
build_steps.control: Unknown groups preserved; component n>=10; unmatched survey rows reported
build_steps.recovery: Return unavailable with coverage when support is insufficient
build_steps.completion_evidence: Known-answer and fault-injection regression contracts pass
build_steps.validation: Result fidelity and real-world measurement validity remain separate; prospective organizational validation required for stronger predictive claims

build_steps.name: Render evidence from the correct snapshot
build_steps.executor: shared provenance validator + snapshot middleware + React consumers
inputs: Dataset-bound evidence including nulls, sample counts and assumptions
build_steps.action: Validate population/probabilities; reject overlapping dataset/model changes; preserve missing vs zero; reset query results after switches
build_steps.control: No fabricated zero, categorical rewrite, incompatible comparison or individual proxy ranking
build_steps.recovery: HTTP409/retry or explicit unavailable state; no old value fallback
build_steps.completion_evidence: Known-answer and fault-injection regression contracts pass
build_steps.validation: Result fidelity and real-world measurement validity remain separate; prospective organizational validation required for stronger predictive claims

build_steps.name: Enforce identity at every mutation
inputs: Transport, browser origin, server identity and requested operation
build_steps.action: Validate local trust and explicit role permission before the handler executes
build_steps.state_transition: request -> authorized execution or denied without mutation
build_steps.control: New remote mutation routes denied until mapped; legacy file sessions return410
build_steps.recovery: Correct configuration; never infer owner from untrusted proxy headers

build_steps.completion_evidence: Candidate-specific local and CI evidence recorded in the quality cycle; pending gates remain explicit
build_steps.validation: Use-case-specific acceptance, not proof of enterprise validity or perfect trust

build_steps.control: No generated factual prose, invented question coverage or unsupported causal inference
build_steps.recovery: Deterministic cited fallback and visible limitations

build_steps.name: Preserve corrupt metadata before recovery
build_steps.trigger: Startup read or explicit runtime recovery
inputs: Existing registry bytes and local runtime lock
build_steps.action: Fail closed on malformed startup metadata; quarantine and verify before explicit shell reconstruction
build_steps.state_transition: corrupt metadata -> preserved quarantine -> degraded shell -> explicit dataset reconciliation
build_steps.control: Never silently discard existing bytes or advertise full historical recovery
build_steps.recovery: Restore a verified backup when startup is blocked; inspect quarantine and reconcile history

build_steps.completion_evidence: Candidate-specific local and CI evidence recorded in the quality cycle; pending gates remain explicit

build_steps.control: No response mocks, retries hiding flakes or substitution of SSR for browser evidence

build_steps.name: Run bounded specialist improvement cycles
build_steps.executor: Authorized review automation and specialist agents
inputs: Current repository head, active CI and durable quality backlog
build_steps.action: Finish pending verification, reproduce prioritized gaps, delegate disjoint fixes and publish a reviewable candidate
build_steps.state_transition: baseline -> findings -> fixes -> independent gates -> next backlog
build_steps.control: One integrating cycle; no automatic merge, deployment, real HR ingestion or employment action
build_steps.recovery: Checkpoint incomplete work; report blocked gates without weakening them

analytics_validation.scope: synthetic and public benchmark validation; enterprise acceptance remains conditional
analytics_validation.model_gate: Fold-local raw-data CV; employee holdout; Brier and AP baselines; weighted calibration and class support
analytics_validation.forecast_boundary: Retrospective classification is not validated future-departure prediction
analytics_validation.remaining: Prospective temporal and subgroup validation on source-verified organization data
analytics_validation.extended_integrity: tests/test_extended_integrity.py: active team denominators, recorded succession assessment coverage, survey joins/dates, hiring exposure, vector replacement/alignment and fail-closed agent evidence
analytics_validation.runtime_scope: Single local workforce runtime, single application process; no non-local data isolation or cross-process mutation guarantee

quality_cycle.mode: bounded specialist review, fix, independent acceptance, reviewable candidate
